name: How long does a steam shower installation typically take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a steam shower installation typically take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a steam shower installation varies depending on whether it's part of a larger bathroom renovation or a standalone project. With AKN Design Group, a comprehensive spa-inspired bathroom remodel, including a steam shower, typically ranges from several weeks to a few months. We provide clear communication regarding project timelines and scheduling transparency from concept to completion, ensuring you understand each phase of the managed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies based on project scope, from weeks to months for a full bathroom remodel including a steam shower.
